title: Cassoulet a Noelle

ingredients.name: cans assorted beans (Northern, kidney, back, garbanzo, navy, sm white), drained
Could serve with: black rice, potatoes, green veggies, green salad, citrus salad

steps.text: Cut sausage into bite-size chunks. In a large, heavy pot, brown sausage in a little oil; remove and set aside.
Add celery and onion (leeks). Saute a couple minutes, then add spices and brown sugar. Saute several minutes more.
Return sausage and add beans (drained), and tomatoes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour over low heat.

notes: Note: Can put into a 2 quart casserole and freeze. To reheat, bake at 400 for 1.25 hours. Optional additions: 4 oz lardons, 4 garlic cloves, 1/2 tsp allspice, bay leaf, 1/2 C white vermouth VARIATIONS: Omit sausage, replace with 3 medium carrots. Replace rosemary with 1/8 tsp cloves and 1 bay leaf. Use only 3 cans beans. Top with Garlic Crumbs. GARLIC CRUMBS: Heat oven to 350 and set rack in center of oven. In a medium bowl, combine crumbs, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper. Spread on a large baking sheet and cook for 12-15 minutes. When cooled, return to bowl and toss with parsley.
